text:
ana-product: Quick update — we shipped prime-cache prefetch + relaxed eviction policy to canary this morning. early telemetry looks solid.
sam-runtime: give numbers? p50/p95/p99 and token cost?
ana-product: p50 -2%, p95 -12%, p99 -22% on conversational workloads with short prefixes. per-token cost down ~14% in the canary subset.
kevin-bench: nice. any adverse effects on memory or eviction churn?
ana-product: eviction churn decreased because we prefetch hot prefixes into a fast slab. GPU mem delta +80MB per worker on average (within budget). no OOMs observed.
tasha-sre: did you update alerts for memory bump?
ana-product: yes — new alert: gpu_mem.used > baseline+150MB for 10m. also added eviction-thrash-rate metric.
sam-runtime: what did we change exactly?
ana-product: two changes: 1) prime-cache prefetcher warms KV cache for recent prefixes proactively; 2) eviction policy switched from LRU->LRU-2 with weight decay to keep hot-prefetch items longer. both implemented in runtime layer, no kernel changes.
kevin-bench: bench command:```bash
./prime_bench --model conv-large --qps 300 --seq-dist short --dur 40m --prefetch prime-cache --evict lru2
```
sam-runtime: baseline vs canary numbers?
ana-product: baseline p99 240ms -> canary 187ms; p95 96ms -> 84ms; cost/token $0.00053 -> $0.00046; avg kv-hit +28%.
ceo-alex: great — this is the kind of ops+product combo we want showcased. can we distill into a 1-line for the announcement?
ana-product: "Prime-cache prefetch and smarter eviction reduce p99 by up to 22% and lower per-token cost by ~14% for prefix-heavy conv workloads."
tasha-sre: rollout plan?
ana-product: staged rollout: canary -> 20% -> 50% -> full over 6h, checks at each step: p99, kv-hit, 5xx. auto-rollback if p99 regresses >6% for 10m.
kevin-bench: validated on quantized and fp16 variants?
ana-product: yes validated on fp16/int8; int4 paths show similar kv-hit improvements.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated for group: conv-prime-canary. 20% -> health checks running.
sam-runtime: monitoring looks clean so far. saw a small blip in eviction-thrash-rate at T+12m but it stabilized.
kevin-bench: please post the bench graphs and config knobs in the eng-runtime channel after full roll.
ana-product: will post a short writeup and link to PR #4218.
ceo-alex: thanks team — lean release note drafted: "Improved prefix caching reduces latency and cost for conversational workloads; gradual rollout with memory and kv-thrash safeguards."
tasha-sre: nice work everyone :tada:
